title: Barbara C NDE 25
content: I was undergoing an operation to remove my gall bladder. The first thing I remember was sort of rolling over, and then I felt myself being pulled backwards towards the ceiling. I looked down and saw a person laying on an operating table covered in green drapes. I realized it was me, but didn't feel any remorse at leaving my body. Then I was pulled backwards again only this time at great speed, I was still travelling backwards and was terrified. I reached out to try to grab something to stop myself but there was only blackness. There was blackness like I'd never seen before. I don't know how long this went on for, it could have been a few seconds and then again it could have been a few years! I then heard a sound telling me to 'Go Back'. The sound was neither male nor female it was a bit like music. The next thing I remember was hearing voices telling me to breathe. There seemed to be a bit of a commotion going on.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes It was like my body was made of light, it still felt like a body but when I looked at it, it wasn't really there!
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time didn't seem to exist.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was black and very wide.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told to go back. It never occurred to me to argue with this!
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told to go back. It never occurred to me to argue with this! God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I'm not so rushed and panicky, people matter to me much more. I feel I have a purpose in life.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I'm not so rushed and panicky, people matter to me much more. I feel I have a purpose in life. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was totally mind-blowing, fantastic and supernatural.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I'd tell when the phone was going to ring or friends were going to visit. I seemed to have a strange energy. The radio would turn on as I passed it. Light globes blow when I press the switch. I started to 'feel' things about people; I have a tremendous urge to heal. I started to see peoples' auras.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was the transformation after it. The worst part was the tremendous speed.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some people think I'm crazy. Some are very interested and ask me loads of questions. Some come to me for help.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Repeated noises freak me out. I can't tolerate loud noises and bright lights.
